I be farmer for here North East, and this my maize plot na small one, 0.83 hectare. My husband and me, we dey try our best but money no plenty, so I go buy small NPK and small urea if the subsidy reach our village this year — maybe enough to put like 30 kg of nitrogen for one hectare, not more. I go use the manure from my goats and small chickens to help the soil, and I go plant the seed I keep from last year because improved seed too costly and sometimes no dey reach us. Rain na the one I go rely on, and me and my children go do most of the work, but for planting and weeding I go call two or three people to help small.
